body:
**CL term**
[CL_0001041](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0001041) — CD8-positive, CXCR3-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cell  

**Suggested revision of class hierarchy**
Change the property for C-X-C chemokine receptor type 3 from `has part` to `has plasma membrane part` ([RO_0002104](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_0002104)).  

**Rationale**  
Currently, the C-X-C chemokine receptor type 3 of CL_0001041 is described with the `has part` property. We suggest changing this to `has plasma membrane part`, which more accurately reflects the localization of CXCR3.  

For example, the following CXCR3-labeled terms are described with `lacks_plasma_membrane_part`:  
- [CL_0001051](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0001051) — CD4-positive, CXCR3-negative, CCR6-negative, alpha-beta T cell  
[CL_0001052](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0001052) — CD8-positive, CXCR3-negative, CCR6-negative, alpha-beta T cell 

**Additional Note**
Upon examining other CL terms, it appears that the following PR terms are described not only with “has (or lacks) plasma membrane part” but also with “has part” or “lacks part.” It is unclear whether this distinction is made intentionally.:
immunoglobulin iota chain (PR_000001858)
immunoglobulin lambda-like polypeptide 1 (PR_000001859)
protein c-Fos (PR_000007597)
myeloperoxidase (PR_000010543)
transcription factor PU.1 (PR_000001944)
V(D)J recombination-activating protein 1 (PR_000003457)
V(D)J recombination-activating protein 2 (PR_000003460)

Thank you for your consideration.
title: [Class hierarchy] Change CXCR3 property in CD8+ CXCR3+ alpha-beta regulatory T cell
